description_en: Retrieves device configurations of an edge instance in batches
description_zh: 批量获取边缘实例设备配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-get-edge-instance-device-config --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --iot-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGetEdgeInstanceDeviceConfig

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

parameters.description_en:
The list of device IDs to query. You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~) operation to query device IDs in an instance.

> You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call.
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的设备ID列表。可调用[QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~)查询实例中的设备ID。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个设备ID。
